recheck.summary: Dade County Federal Credit Union / Evermore Bank

fields.notes: 10th CU purchase of a bank announced in 2026. Gives DCFCU its first Palm Beach County location.

recheck.summary: Sunmark Credit Union / Directors Choice Credit Union

fields.notes: Directors Choice serves funeral directors; application filed with NY DFS. It is to stop operating on its own at the end of 2026.

recheck.summary: MAX Credit Union / First Financial Bank

fields.notes: First Financial Bank is in Bessemer, AL. Ninth CU purchase of a bank announced in 2026; MAX plans to keep all eight branches.
fields.next_steps: FirstFed Bancorp shareholder and regulatory approval

recheck.summary: SELCO Community Credit Union / Numerica Credit Union

fields.notes: Merger of equals: SELCO's Oregon charter continues, under the Numerica name, led by Numerica's CEO. SELCO CEO Bob Newcomb retires at completion. Expected by early 2028.
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and a Numerica member vote

recheck.summary: Financial Plus Credit Union / Monroe Community Credit Union

fields.notes: Financial Plus's merger page says the combined CU keeps the Financial Plus name, with 20 locations. The announcement doesn't name the legal survivor, the CEO or timing; check it when the NCUA vote notice appears.

recheck.summary: PenAir Credit Union / Fort McClellan Credit Union

fields.notes: Combined CU keeps the PenAir name: 22 locations in AL, FL and VA.
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and a Fort McClellan member vote (special meeting expected early 2027)

recheck.summary: DFCU Financial Credit Union / Gulfside Bank

fields.notes: Gulfside branches to be rebranded DFCU, with integration in the second half of 2027.
fields.announced_figures: DFCU at $8B in assets; no combined figures released

recheck.summary: CommunityAmerica Credit Union / WeStreet Credit Union

fields.notes: NCUA approved; proposed effective date Jan 1, 2027 (NCUA member notice). Combined CU operates as CommunityAmerica under CEO Lisa Ginter; WeStreet CEO Greg Gallant becomes market president for Oklahoma and Arkansas. No WeStreet branch closures.
fields.footprint: MO, CA, OK, KS, AR, TX, AL, KY, MI, NE, IN, MS, NC, NV, TN, WV
fields.next_steps: WeStreet member vote, counted at a special meeting on Nov 20, 2026

recheck.summary: Michigan State University Federal Credit Union / University Federal Credit Union

fields.acquirer: Michigan State University Federal Credit Union
fields.notes: Combined CU takes UFCU's name and MSUFCU's charter, keeping both brands (UFCU in Texas, MSUFCU in Michigan and Illinois). MSUFCU CEO April Clobes to be CEO; UFCU CEO Michael Crowl becomes president.

recheck.summary: First Responders Credit Union / Lynn Firemen's Federal Credit Union

fields.announced_figures: Two branches, in Dorchester and Lynn; all employees retained
fields.notes: Added Nov 21, 2026 (missed at announcement). First Responders CU is the former Boston Firefighters CU (renamed June 2026). The release gives an anticipated effective date of March 2026, which predates the October announcement and looks like a typo for 2027; close left as Not Disclosed until confirmed.

recheck.summary: Streator Onized Credit Union / ANCO Community Credit Union

fields.notes: On NCUA's proposed-merger list. No public announcement found yet.

recheck.summary: On Tap Credit Union / Sky Federal Credit Union

fields.notes: Joint member site names Tracie Wilcox CEO and Daisy Romo President (CEO succession) of the combined CU; regulatory application filed; expected to take effect around mid-2027. Sky becomes a division under On Tap's charter, HQ Golden, CO. No branch closures planned.
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and a Sky FCU member vote

recheck.summary: Consumers Credit Union / Scott Credit Union

fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and a Scott CU member vote
fields.notes: Intent to combine; Scott CU members vote.

recheck.summary: Gulf Winds Credit Union / Peoples Exchange Bank

fields.notes: Announced in a Friday release (Banking Dive, Sep 29). Regulatory approval expected mid-2027; integration by 2028. One of two Gulf Winds bank purchases.

recheck.summary: Sierra Central Credit Union / First U.S. Community Credit Union

fields.next_steps: A First U.S. member vote, expected in Q1 2027
fields.notes: Sierra Central's merger page anticipates legal day one in Q2 2027. First U.S. CEO Shonna Shearson leads the combined CU; Sierra Central CEO Ron Sweeney retires at completion.

recheck.summary: Gulf Winds Credit Union / Madison County Community Bank

fields.notes: Gulf Winds renames itself TruWorth CU in spring 2027. Regulatory approval expected mid-2027; integration by 2028. One of two Gulf Winds bank purchases.

recheck.summary: Gesa Credit Union / Willamette Valley Bank

fields.notes: Gives Gesa its first Oregon branches.
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and Oregon Bancorp shareholder approval

recheck.summary: Nutmeg State Financial Credit Union / New Haven Teachers Federal Credit Union

fields.partner: New Haven Teachers Federal Credit Union
fields.notes: Announced date is Nutmeg's application to the CT Dept. of Banking, which approved the merger Jul 29. Expected to close in December. Nutmeg is also converting to a federal charter as Nutmeg State FCU.

recheck.summary: Baxter Credit Union / HealthCare Associates Credit Union

fields.notes: On NCUA's proposed-merger list. No public announcement found yet.
fields.footprint: IL, PR, MN, CA, GA, AR, FL, IN, MA, MS, NC, OH, UT, VA, WI

recheck.summary: LOC Credit Union / Advantage One Credit Union

fields.notes: Advantage One members approved Jul 15. LOC takes the Advantage One name on the effective date; Chris Corkery becomes president. Systems and brand integration planned for May 2027.

recheck.summary: Team One Credit Union / CASE Credit Union

fields.notes: Member vote was set for Oct 20, 2026; result not yet confirmed. Expected to take effect in January 2027 ("Bolder Together").

recheck.summary: Ascend Federal Credit Union / LGE Community Credit Union

fields.notes: Ascend's first out-of-state merger. Regulators approved in September and LGE's member vote began.
fields.next_steps: LGE member vote (set for Nov 9, 2026); result not yet confirmed

recheck.summary: Metro Credit Union / Members Plus Credit Union

fields.notes: Member vote was set for Oct 16, 2026; result not yet confirmed. Combined: 25 branches.

recheck.summary: Alabama ONE Credit Union / Peoples Independent Bank

fields.notes: Alabama State Banking Dept. approved the purchase in July 2026. Peoples Independent Bank's website now shows the Alabama ONE brand, suggesting the purchase has closed; FDIC still lists the bank as active.

recheck.summary: Zeal Credit Union / The Miners State Bank

fields.notes: First CU purchase of a bank announced in 2026. Adds five Upper Peninsula branches.
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and MSB Bankshares stockholder approval
